written_before: any T1 region reply or T2 dense reply on RetargetVid was read

splits.dedup: RetargetVid videos are the DHF1K source files themselves (byte-identical, checked on 001/025); each source id appears in exactly one split; no frames or derived crops cross splits

T1.single_change: Qwen output = target-ratio-aware subject_box + context_box (prompt states window size and slide axis); deterministic mapping 'fit' to a legal max-window centre; same keyframes (1 s + shot starts), 640 px, NOFACE gate, B0 EMA/resets, all-select, max width
T1.hypothesis: Telling the teacher the window constraint and asking for a region to keep (incl. interaction/action objects) places the window better than a subject point
T1.falsified_if: confirm2 paired REGIONNF_fit - N0 CI95 upper bound < 0

T2.single_change: keyframe density 2x inside shots (0.5 s grid, superset of the 1 s grid; shared keyframe replies reused byte-identically from the parent run); same point prompt, 640 px, gate, path
T2.hypothesis: Sparse 1 s points lose IoU on interpolated frames; fresh points at 0.5 s improve IoU
T2.falsified_if: confirm2 paired DENSENF - N0 CI95 upper bound < 0, or propagation analysis shows fresh vs held IoU difference < .005

T3.parent: N0 (bbox on every kept frame byte-identical to N0)
T3.single_change: temporal keep mask from 32B removal-only judgement with whole-video overview + local context; default keep-all
T3.status: hypothesis; package only as diagnostic after public proxy audit

package_rule.inconclusive: otherwise; package as a diagnostic only if dev2+confirm2 pooled mean >= 0 and official predictions change >= 10% of frames vs N0

size_policy: record loaded params and weight bytes; params tier 100-500M x0.95, 500M-9B x0.90; 32B teacher is a research teacher result (raw score), not a compliant student
